text_block_list.name: Training Partner
text_block_list.text:
W-We did it! Did I really beat Ai-chan in 
our match race...!?

text_block_list.name: Training Partner
text_block_list.text:
Still, running like this in the middle of 
a tough rotation? I'd expect nothing 
less... Ah! Want to go again? I won't lose 
next time!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... Thank you—but I'll pass for 
today.

text_block_list.name: Training Partner
text_block_list.text:
W-Whaaat!? No way... Ai-chan isn't... 
coming for a rematch!?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Challenging you in my current state... 
would be disrespectful. ...I'll reach out 
to you again another day.
